settings.description_override: A little mischief for an everyday bag. The Cherry Charm brings a playful fruit silhouette and a touch of shine to the handle you reach for most. It is a small, personal flourish that makes even the simplest outfit feel more like yours.
settings.fact_detail: Rounded cherry forms and a shaped leaf give the charm its recognizable outline, with a finish specific to each colorway.

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: A paired-cherry bag charm with a leaf detail and attachment hardware. Shape, surface and hardware finish vary by colorway; the selected photographs show the version you are choosing.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth and avoid soaking, perfume and abrasive cleaners.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Please allow 10 days from your order to dispatch. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. You will receive tracking details when your order ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
